subject: Pilot onboarding sponsorship — credits & T&Cs
messages:
From: Kayla Price <kayla@seedframe.vc>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot sponsorship for Nov cohort — credits & timing

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking a call last week. SeedFrame's November cohort starts Dec 6 and we're exploring a small set of partner pilots — we'd love Redwood as our model/infra partner. Two quick questions before I put the ask to the selection committee:

1) Can you provide a 6-month pilot credit pack (recommended: $10k worth of hosted credits) with the ability to be partially used by two startups in the cohort?
2) Do you support a short trial promo where credits are refundable/unspent after 90 days, or are credits non-refundable by policy?

If you can share a stub SOW and any sponsor T&Cs, I'll route to procurement. We're on a tight timeline — hoping to confirm sponsors by Nov 30.

Best,
Kayla
Program Lead, SeedFrame Labs

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kayla Price <kayla@seedframe.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sponsorship for Nov cohort — credits & timing

Kayla — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline.

Short answers up front:
- We can offer a $10k hosted credit allocation for the cohort, splitable between up to two startups.
- Standard credits are non-refundable, but we can add a 90-day rollover clause or a pro-rated refund clause in exceptional cases (requires Legal sign-off).

I've attached a draft sponsor terms PDF and a one-page SOW stub for the pilot (attachments: SeedFrame_Sponsor_Terms_v1.pdf). Before I send these to procurement, two internal items to confirm:

- Ben: can we approve the partial refund language for cohort pilots as an exception?
- Marissa: any constraints on how we label/promote "sponsored credits" in the cohort materials?

If you're OK, I'll send the redlined T&Cs plus a HubSpot deal link so we can track the commitment.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sponsorship for Nov cohort — credits & timing

Hannah / Marissa — quick internal note before external sign-off.

I support the $10k pilot credit split, but two caveats:
- Refunds create tracking and accounting overhead. If we do a restitution clause, it should be pro-rated and only triggered by material breach (e.g., startup doesn't complete onboarding or misuses API). No unconditional refunds.
- We should cap per-startup consumption at $7.5k during the first 60 days to avoid heavy consumption by one cohort member.

If Legal wants to review, we can add a short schedule noting refundable conditions and an audit right. Otherwise, Hannah you can send the terms as-is with the two caveats inserted.

-Ben
Director, Partnerships Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kayla Price <kayla@seedframe.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sponsorship for Nov cohort — credits & T&Cs
Attachments: Redwood_Pilot_SOW_SeedFrame.docx

Hi Kayla — attaching the SOW and updated sponsor terms with Ben's caveats included. Highlights:
- $10,000 hosted credit package, splitable between up to two cohort startups.
- Per-startup cap: $7,500 in the first 60 days, then open to use of remaining balance.
- Refund policy: credits are generally non-refundable. We will include a pro-rated refund clause limited to documented onboarding failure or misuse, subject to audit and Redwood approval.
- Credits expire after 6 months; unused balances can be reallocated to SeedFrame within that period if both parties agree.

Next steps from our side: I can push this into HubSpot and generate a DocuSign SOW. Can you confirm: (a) which two startups (names/emails) you'd like to pre-allocate to, and (b) do you need Redwood branding language on the cohort page?

Proposed timeline: finalize terms by Nov 30 -> sign SOW Dec 1 -> credits live Dec 6.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if you'd like to walk through.

Best,
Hannah

From: Kayla Price <kayla@seedframe.vc>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sponsorship for Nov cohort — credits & T&Cs

Hannah — this looks great, thank you.

Confirming: we'll pre-allocate to:
- NovaMind Labs (ceo@novamind.ai)
- OrbitAnalytics (founder@orbitanalytics.com)

We don't require Redwood branding on the public page — internal acknowledgement is fine. Please send the DocuSign link for the SOW and we'll route for signatures on our side today.
Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to have Redwood on board for the cohort.

Best,
Kayla
Program Lead, SeedFrame Labs
